name: PageScribe — Local document converter
description: Convert PDF, images with English/Arabic OCR, PowerPoint, Office files and archives to Markdown locally.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://media.githubusercontent.com https://raw.githubusercontent.com; base-uri 'none'
